actualTrackingIssueBody:
## Outcome

**No-gain; original source/product restored.** No optimization commit or performance PR.
The compatible `ResponseStream.Flush` completed-success guard leaves prepared synchronous
Flush near 20 ns and about 1% slower in both completed pairs. Ordinary full-request gains
reverse; unchanged async controls and allocation residuals are retained.

Three source-comparison attempt slots are permanently consumed: one setup-only failed
original attempt with no statistical sample, then two complete opposite-order pairs.
This is not three successful comparisons. All 24 reported rows/192 result samples remain.

## Immutable evidence

- [Full result, boundaries and requirement matrix](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/68c7fba6842e0655e064b1bded470534ce80bc48/F032/README.md)
- [Every target/control comparison](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/68c7fba6842e0655e064b1bded470534ce80bc48/F032/comparison-results.md)
- [Audited disposition and limitations](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/68c7fba6842e0655e064b1bded470534ce80bc48/F032/decision.json)
- [Exact commands with actual exit codes](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/68c7fba6842e0655e064b1bded470534ce80bc48/F032/validation-commands.md)
- [Runnable benchmark project/source](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/68c7fba6842e0655e064b1bded470534ce80bc48/F032/harness)
- [Failed setup attempt](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/68c7fba6842e0655e064b1bded470534ce80bc48/F032/profiles/round-1-original)
- [Unchanged independent source branch](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/autoperf/F032-httpsys-flush-start)

## Owning behavior and validation

Actual public `UseHttpSys`, ephemeral loopback HTTP/1.1, accepted request-owned
`ResponseStream`/`OnResponseStart`/`OnStarting` and native response; no injected framework
start task, replacement stream or fabricated native request context.

Both original and candidate pass the same 15 native functional rows, zero skipped,
including both Boolean theory values. Corrected original/candidate/independently rebuilt
relocated images each pass six completed profiles, 12 additional real producer/wire
contracts and six actual benchmark lifecycles. Earlier 18-contract images remain.

Real pending callbacks keep synchronous Flush unfinished and wire headers unavailable
until release, while public `HasStarted` is already true and headers remain mutable.
LIFO, actual payload/protocol, exact failure/token, default synchronous-I/O rejection
and async controls are checked. Cancellation is callback-gate cancellation, not
`RequestAborted`; a nonblocking synchronous return is incompatible.

Full-request timings include loopback/client/dispatch/bookkeeping/wire consumption.
Prepared-live timings perform one Flush on a held, actually started response with no
new network operation; they are not application throughput or isolated awaiter costs.
`Ready.64` is 64 flushes in one request, not 64 callbacks.

The pinned in-process BDN emitter initially does not await asynchronous lifecycle
methods. Retain the null-statistics failure; only untimed lifecycle adapters change.
An incremental source-restoration build also fails its owner-hash postcondition;
forced owner-only recompilation matches the original tested owners. Initial uncharacterized
preparation has 11 warnings; authoritative/relocated standalone builds have 0 warnings/0 errors.

Measured harness DLL/PDB and 184 other consumer files are identical; only actual tested
HTTP.sys DLL/PDB differ. Nine selected PE/PDB/source associations per native invocation,
not complete compiler provenance/coverage. All 192 stdout/JSON samples and 48+2 settings
observations are audited on a shared, non-isolated Windows VM with no priority/affinity/
power/OS/network-policy modifications.

Live physical audit: 1,259 unique files/5,795 bindings, including 1,116 consumer and
4,589 loaded-assembly bindings. Forty-seven successful native listeners have explicit
disposal receipts. The failed process lacks graceful listener-disposal evidence; its
exit/absence is recorded. Portable audit rehashes copied text, not omitted binaries.

No structural allocation saving, production-frequency, application-speedup, starvation,
deadlock or merge-ready claim. F033 (`Write`) remains independent and unfinished.
